items.text: Post-Sunday injury watch list includes Lamar (ankle), Chase (concussion)/Higgins (adductor), Saquon (hamstring), Rice (hamstring)/Thornton (ankle), McConkey (foot agg), DJ Moore (shoulder), Pat Bryant (ankle) and others.
items.why: Comprehensive ETR Sunday injuries tracking for fantasy impact.
items.implication: Multiple high-priority statuses to track into Week 5 practices/reports; beneficiaries across boards.
items.opportunity: Handcuffs, waivers, and role expansions for affected teams' backups.

items.text: Lamar Jackson believed day-to-day with ankle injury after leaving vs Titans; exited stadium in protective boot. Questionable to return in-game then did not.
items.why: Ankle injury scrambling; boot post-game; monitored/treated this week. Early mild high-ankle indications unconfirmed.
items.implication: Ravens QB situation fluid for Week 5; Huntley filled in. High fantasy impact if misses.
items.opportunity: Backup QB and Ravens skill upside if Lamar limited/out.

items.text: Ja'Marr Chase ruled out with concussion after facemask hit and evaluation in second quarter vs Jaguars; will enter concussion protocol. Tee Higgins also suffered adductor injury late.
items.why: Facemask drag and hit to head; ruled out for second half and rest of game; protocol next.
items.implication: Bengals WR corps depleted; monitor protocol clearance for Week 5 vs MIA. Higgins adductor extent unknown.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining Bengals pass-catchers including Chase Brown in pass game.

items.text: Saquon Barkley downgraded to OUT with hamstring injury after pulling up on first-quarter run vs Rams; finished with minimal production.
items.why: Hamstring issue on sweep/run; evaluated and ruled out before halftime. Already managing prior stinger.
items.implication: Eagles RB room thin; monitor severity for Week 5. Already missing other starters.
items.opportunity: Goal-line/third-down/snap share to Tank Bigsby and Will Shipley.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love frustrated with snap management (not injury); coaches managing workload/body for long season, limiting crucial-situation plays. He accepts but wants more.
items.why: Post-game comments: ankle maintenance + overall body management; limited second-half snaps in close game.
items.implication: ARI RB committee/split continues; ceiling capped short-term despite talent.
items.opportunity: Handcuff/backup upside (Tyler/Bam) in goal-line/two-minute; Love still core but not full.

items.text: Rashee Rice downgraded to doubtful with hamstring after first-quarter tweak vs Raiders; did not return. Chiefs already showing interest in Tyreek Hill.
items.why: Hamstring pull on catch; Reid called tweak; out for game.
items.implication: Chiefs WR depth tested especially with Thornton also down; monitor Week 5.
items.opportunity: Targets to Xavier Worthy and others; possible Hill signing boosts overall.

items.text: Ladd McConkey active (expected to play per pregame) but aggravated foot injury, ruled out for remainder of Week 4 vs Seahawks after limited targets.
items.why: Foot (plus prior ribs); active pregame but aggravated in-game, no catches on 2 targets then done.
items.implication: Bigger dock already per Levitan; uncertain for Week 5 vs DEN. Chargers WR thin.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets to Quentin Johnston and other LAC WRs.
items.conflict: Pregame expected/active vs in-game exit; ETR bigger dock correct signal.

items.text: Eagles could be without four key players vs Rams: RT Lane Johnson (personal, Q), WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring), TE Dallas Goedert (knee), LB Zack Baun (concussion). Situation worsening.
items.why: Multiple injuries + personal; Schefter on Johnson Q personal.
items.implication: PHI offense compromised (already Saquon out); matchup softer for LAR.
items.opportunity: Rams pass-catchers (Nacua) and PHI backups elevated; reverse if unexpected returns.

items.text: Puka Nacua expected to play with only small dock on projections; Rams do not intend to limit workload per Schefter. Upgrade from prior snap-count fears.
items.why: Groin/hip return; Schefter report no snap limit intent; ETR expected and small dock only.
items.implication: Full-ish WR1 role vs depleted Eagles secondary/OL; strong fantasy start.
items.opportunity: High routes/targets/red-zone without restriction; reverse prior beneficiary concerns.

items.text: Terry McLaurin not expected to play (hamstring); confirmed inactive context in weekend reports.
items.why: ETR weekend summary NOT EXPECTED; Schefter/others align on inactive.
items.implication: Commanders WR targets shift; monitor return timeline.
items.opportunity: Increased role for Deebo Samuel, others in WAS passing game.

items.text: Chuba Hubbard is this year's Javonte Williams: boring mid-round RB no one wanted due to talent/role questions who ends up starting and crushing.
items.why: Post-Week 4 reflection on mid-round sleeper who secured role and produced.
items.implication: ROS RB starter trust; hold/start confidently in fantasy.
items.opportunity: Continued carries/snap share in CAR backfield.

items.text: DJ Moore aggravated shoulder injury vs Patriots; not considered a long-term issue as of now.
items.why: Shoulder aggravation in-game; source says not long-term currently.
items.implication: Monitor practice Week 5; BUF WR depth if limited.
items.opportunity: If out/limited, targets to other Bills receivers.

items.text: Zay Flowers expected to play with tinier dock; not expected to have hard pitch count per reporting.
items.why: Hamstring; ETR expected; Levitan tinier dock, Fowler no hard pitch count.
items.implication: Near-normal usage for Ravens WR1 with Lamar status separate issue.
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets if Lamar plays; monitor any soft limit.

items.text: Mike Evans GTD/optimistic but bigger dock on projections due to ribs.
items.why: Ribs; ETR GTD/optimistic; Levitan notes bigger dock vs Nacua/Flowers.
items.implication: Risky start; monitor final active/inactive and any limit if plays.
items.opportunity: If out, TB WR/TE upside; if in limited, still volume potential.
